data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterhemelingen (tax office) issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for the year 2025, dated 19 November 2026. It set the income tax at €5,820.00 against €6,390.00 of wage tax already withheld, resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €570.00 to be transferred to the taxpayer's account.
data.explanation: This is the official tax office's calculation of your 2025 income tax. Because more wage tax had been withheld than you owe, you get a refund of €570.00, which the Finanzamt says it will transfer to your account automatically — no action needed for that. If you disagree with any part of the calculation (e.g. which income or expenses were counted), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final. Consider professional tax advice if the figures look wrong to you.

remedy.period_text: Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt einen Monat und rechnet ab der Bekanntgabe; ein Bescheid, der als Brief verschickt wird, ist am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als bekannt gegeben anzusehen.
remedy.form_text: Er bedarf der Schriftform oder der elektronischen Übermittlung; Sie können ihn aber auch an Amtsstelle zur Niederschrift erklären.
remedy.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann mit dem Einspruch angefochten werden.

data.tax_note: This document is the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 itself and should be kept with your tax records; it also confirms that contributions to disability insurance (Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung) were not deductible because the Vorsorgeaufwendungen limit was already used up by health and long-term care insurance.
